styles.root: max-width: 677px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0; color: #332C27; background-color: #FFFFFF; word-break: break-word;
styles.title: margin: 0 0 22px; padding: 0; color: #8C1D18; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: center;
styles.summary: margin: 0 0 20px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #4A4038; background-color: #FBF7F1; border-left: 3px solid #B8860B; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.2px;
styles.heading: margin: 28px 0 14px; padding: 0 0 8px; color: #8C1D18; border-bottom: 1px solid #E0C9A6; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5;
styles.paragraph: margin: 0 0 16px; padding: 0; color: #333333; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.3px; text-indent: 2em;
styles.highlight: margin: 18px 0; padding: 12px 14px; color: #332C27; background-color: #FBF7F1; border-left: 3px solid #B8860B; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
styles.quote: margin: 20px 0; padding: 12px 14px; color: #4A4038; background-color: #FFFDF9; border-left: 3px solid #8C1D18; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.2px;
styles.quote_source: margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 0; color: #666666; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; text-align: right;
styles.data_table: width: 100%; margin: 18px 0; border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid #E0C9A6;
styles.data_label: padding: 10px 12px; color: #332C27; background-color: #FBF7F1; border: 1px solid #E0C9A6; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.6; vertical-align: top;
styles.data_value: padding: 10px 12px; color: #8C1D18; border: 1px solid #E0C9A6; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.6; vertical-align: top;
styles.image: display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 100%; height: auto; margin: 20px 0 8px;
styles.image_placeholder: margin: 20px 0 8px; padding: 12px 14px; color: #666666; background-color: #FFFDF9; border: 1px dashed #E0C9A6; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; text-align: center;
styles.image_caption: margin: 0 0 20px; padding: 0; color: #666666; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; text-align: center;
styles.footer: margin: 32px 0 0; padding: 14px 0 0; color: #666666; border-top: 1px solid #E0C9A6; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.8; letter-spacing: 0.1px;
